text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Just now... it felt like a demonic wind blew past...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Is that so... It might just be my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it doesn't feel very pleasant.
After all, the wind only blows when it's meant to...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Is the fatigue catching up to her from running races back-to-back...? Perhaps I should reconsider her schedule.
